goals.label: Reduce errors
goals.summary: Minimize user mistakes, misclicks, and risky actions.
promptDirectives: Prioritize clarity, prevention, and explicit confirmation for risky decisions.
Reduce ambiguity in labels, controls, and system feedback.
Design flows that help users recover safely from mistakes.
successMetrics: Lower misclick or incorrect submission rate

goals.label: Speed up decisions
goals.summary: Help users choose faster with less hesitation.
promptDirectives: Reduce the number of competing options on screen.
Use defaults, grouping, and hierarchy to accelerate choice.
Make the next best action obvious at every step.

goals.label: Reduce overload
goals.summary: Lower cognitive burden and simplify comprehension.
promptDirectives: Chunk information and reveal complexity progressively.
Reduce simultaneous demands on attention and memory.
Favor calm, digestible hierarchy over dense presentation.
successMetrics: Fewer support questions caused by confusion

goals.label: Improve findability
goals.summary: Help users discover the right feature or information quickly.
promptDirectives: Use recognizable navigation and information scent.
Organize information around user mental models.
Reduce clutter that competes with wayfinding cues.
successMetrics: Faster time to find target information
Fewer failed searches or dead-end navigations
Higher task success for discovery flows

goals.label: Improve collaboration
goals.summary: Support shared understanding, handoff, and team confidence.
promptDirectives: Make ownership, status, and next steps explicit.
Show context that improves handoff quality and trust.
Reduce coordination friction across people and roles.
successMetrics: Lower rework caused by missing context
Higher team confidence in workflow state
